subject: adult male boxer, bare torso, red boxing gloves held up in guard, red shorts, dark boxing boots
motion: a one-two combination: a quick lead-hand jab followed by a rear-hand cross, then back to guard
facing: in a three-quarter fighting view facing screen-right

plan.source: Boxer in three-quarter guard facing right, left foot forward, weight centered, gloves up near chin with left slightly ahead, elbows in, knees soft.

frames.pose: Small dip and slight draw of left shoulder; weight shifts to right leg; left glove tight to cheek, right a touch higher; hips preload left; left knee bends; left foot planted, right heel light.

frames.effect: short white streak behind extended left glove, arcing back toward his left shoulder

frames.pose: Retract left to guard; slight rebound back; torso straightens; right still high; left foot planted, right heel lowering.
Wind for cross: rotate hips, right shoulder coils back; left glove screens forward; weight shifts to left leg; left foot planted, right on ball ready to pivot.
Drive right cross full extension; hips rotate through, slight forward lean; left glove tight to cheek; chin down; left foot planted, right ball pivots outward.
frames.effect: short white streak behind extended right glove, curving back toward his right shoulder

frames.pose: Begin cross retraction across center; torso decelerates; left hand edges forward to cover; weight recenters; left foot planted, right heel starts to settle.

Micro drop to match rest; elbows in; head level; stance squared to flow into idle; left foot planted, right relaxed under hip.
